explanation: It grew from medieval notation, where a full circle marked triple time, thought perfect, and a broken circle marked duple time. The broken circle came to look like a C.

claims.text: The C time signature did not begin as an abbreviation of 'common'.
In medieval mensural notation, a full circle indicated triple time (tempus perfectum) and a broken circle indicated duple time (tempus imperfectum).
Medieval theorists regarded triple time as perfect.
The C sign for 4/4 time descends from the broken circle of medieval notation.
